text:
Rhea Kapoor: Magneto asked for a short migration POC next week to prove API parity (they use POST /v1/text.stream), evaluate streaming behavior, and get answers to security questionnaire items + a migration credit.
Tom Nguyen: What are their absolute must-haves?
Rhea Kapoor: 1) identical streaming chunks and stop-token behavior, 2) key residency & HSM import, 3) predictable p95 latency under burst, 4) clear commercial cap for POC spend.
Carlos Mendez: We can emulate their chunked stream by proxying to our SSE endpoint and re-chunking to match their boundaries. Small shim will do.
Tom Nguyen: Quick shim sketch (pseudo):
```js
// proxy /v1/text.stream -> /redwood/stream
proxy(req,res){ const meta=req.headers['x-org']; stream=rw.stream({input:req.body}); stream.on('data', d=>res.write(chunkFormat(d))); }
```
Carlos Mendez: Also recommend HTML normalization middleware and deterministic stop-token handling to reduce output drift.
Rhea Kapoor: Security asks: HSM import, SOC2 report, subprocessor list, cache encryption.
sec-bot: Auto-reply: "HSM supported on Dedicated/Private only. KMS + key-wrap available. SOC2 report on legal portal."
Tom Nguyen: Tokenization parity is likely the trickiest. We should run a 250-sample tokenization + output diff. Carlos, can you spin that up in the parity harness?
Carlos Mendez: On it. Will flag any >1-token deltas and rhetorical output differences.
Rhea Kapoor: Commercial ask: Magneto wants price parity for 30 days while migrating. Sales propose 20% off hosted for 60 days + $8k migration credit if they sign Dedicated LOI within 4 months. POC cap: $2k.
Sales-bot: Proposal logged: 20% discount (60d), migration credit $8,000, POC cap $2,000.
Tom Nguyen: Ops: their SLA target is p95 <250ms for 512 tokens. Recommend a 24-48h Dedicated smoke window to prove p95 stability during POC.
Carlos Mendez: Smoke tests: 200 concurrent small requests, 60 streaming clients, full parity run. I'll request SRE window.
Rhea Kapoor: Action items:
- Carlos: tokenization + output diffs by EOD (1735006000)
- Tom: schedule Dedicated smoke window & canary fallback plan
- Rhea: draft SOW + POC commercial term sheet, include POC cap and migration credit
- Sec-bot: attach security checklist answers before kickoff
Sales-bot: Meeting scheduled: Magneto POC kickoff - Tomorrow 10:30am PT - https://cal.redwood/magneto-poc
Rhea Kapoor: Any objections to the terms above? If not I'll send the offer after finance review.
Tom Nguyen: No infra objections. Need SRE + billing sign-off.
Carlos Mendez: No technical objections; will prioritize parity fixes.
sec-bot: Note: For HSM import we require Dedicated/Private and a short lead time for key onboarding.
Rhea Kapoor: Great. I'll loop Legal for DPA/EULA questions and update the invite with the parity doc link when Carlos posts it. :white_check_mark:
